comment: Independent v12 C-first probe for trap.c:trapeffect_rolling_boulder_trap. A new debug Wizard creates the trap on ordinary floor, leaves its square, returns to trigger it, and dismisses the result pager. This generated corridor had no launch path, so C reaches the explicit “Fortunately for you, no boulder was released” branch. The movement trap and launch-path refusal differ from v11 falling-rock and dart effects.
